text: The first pinned public eyesim reference and rational oracle are implemented under tools/r-parity, with a partial PARITY.md. Correct composite-key/exhaustive-control cosine scores and reductions agree. Image-only query semantics, dropped unmatched source, duplicate references, and constant Pearson are documented. This is one synthetic fixed-grid case; KDE, temporal, multiscale, finite-cap sampling, model fitting and real-study coverage remain pending.
